An estimate for nonnegative polynomials (Lemma lem:K)

For every n\ge1 there is K_n\ge1 such that \max_{0\le t\le1} r(t) \le K_n\int_0^1 r(t)\,dt for every real polynomial r of degree at most n that is nonnegative on [0,1].

The formal proof minimizes \int_0^1|r| over the unit sphere of the coefficient space, which is compact; the article argues by contradiction with Vandermonde interpolation. Both prove the same statement.

noncomputable sectionopen scoped BigOperatorsopen Finsetnamespace LindenstraussPolynomials

Evaluation of the polynomial with coefficient vector c.

def evalc {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : ℝ := ∑ k : Fin (n + 1), c k * t ^ (k : ℕ)
lemma continuous_evalc_uncurry (n : ℕ) : Continuous (Function.uncurry fun (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) => |evalc c t|) := n:ℕ⊢ Continuous (Function.uncurry fun c t ↦ |evalc c t|) n:ℕ⊢ Continuous (Function.uncurry fun c t ↦ |∑ k, c k * t ^ ↑k|) n:ℕ⊢ Continuous fun x ↦ ∑ k, x.1 k * x.2 ^ ↑k n:ℕ⊢ ∀ i ∈ univ, Continuous fun a ↦ a.1 i * a.2 ^ ↑i n:ℕk:Fin (n + 1)a✝:k ∈ univ⊢ Continuous fun a ↦ a.1 k * a.2 ^ ↑k All goals completed! 🐙

Φ(c) = ∫₀¹ |∑ c_k t^k| dt.

def Phi {n : ℕ} (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : ℝ := ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, |evalc c t|
lemma continuous_Phi (n : ℕ) : Continuous (Phi (n := n)) := intervalIntegral.continuous_parametric_intervalIntegral_of_continuous' (continuous_evalc_uncurry n) 0 1lemma evalc_smul {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : evalc (a • c) t = a * evalc c t := n:ℕa:ℝc:Fin (n + 1) → ℝt:ℝ⊢ evalc (a • c) t = a * evalc c t All goals completed! 🐙lemma Phi_smul {n : ℕ} (a : ℝ) (c : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ) : Phi (a • c) = |a| * Phi c := n:ℕa:ℝc:Fin (n + 1) → ℝ⊢ Phi (a • c) = |a| * Phi c n:ℕa:ℝc:Fin (n + 1) → ℝ⊢ ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, |a| * |evalc c t| = |a| * ∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..1, |evalc c t| All goals completed!
